caption: The drawing depicts a single metal pitcher or jug with a lid, rendered in shades of brown and copper, giving it a metallic appearance. The pitcher has a tall, tapered cylindrical shape with three horizontal ridges circling the body at regular intervals. The lid is circular and slightly domed with a knob handle on top, and the pitcher has a large, curved handle attached to the side, also colored in copper tones with some lighter and darker shading to give a sense of light and shadow. The spout is integrated into the mouth of the pitcher and is colored in dark gray or black, suggesting a different material or a shadowed area. The background is a light, plain beige color, and the overall composition centers the pitcher on the page. There is a faint signature in the lower left corner.
title: Coffee Pot
